requests.reply:
Suyeon, are you still at work?
Yes, unfortunately, the meeting hasn't ended. Jiwoo, have you already left?
I just got out. But did the contract go smoothly?

Yeah, I got the stamp yesterday. Now it's really over.
Wow, there are only three days left.
I know, it's so much to do.

Did you hire a moving company?
No, I just did a partial move. I'll have to pack everything myself, and the move is on Saturday.
What about the cat? It's going to be a disaster!

On Saturday, I'll drop off Barley at the pet hotel. I wrote "Barley" on the reservation form because they asked for his name in English.
I'm still confused about whether Barley is male or female.
He's a female. She's three years old, but she's still shy.

Once the move is over, we can relax on Sundays. I also want to see Bori. How about having brunch?
Sounds great! Hyunjin will be coming over on Sunday to help with the cleanup.
Okay, that's good. So Bori will be home that day too?

Yeah, my older brother will pick me up on Sunday morning.
That's good. Will Seobin be coming too?
I asked, but Seobin won't be able to make it on Sunday. She said she has a prior engagement.

That's too bad. Oh, what's the correct English spelling of Chaeyul's name? I need to send out the calendar invitation.
I'll use "Chaeyul." Not "Chaeyool."
Okay. What about the sofa? Bora used to sleep on it all the time.

I put it on Carrot, and I got a message right away. We decided to do a direct transaction tomorrow evening.
Wow, that's fast. 윤, you really took good care of that couch, didn't you?
I know, it's a shame. But since our new apartment is small, there's nothing we can do.

Did you get the deposit for the old house? The landlord was pretty strict.
Yeah, I still need to clean thoroughly before Sunday, as she asked.
Wow, Sunday is a day off. Should I ask Chae-yul to do it?

That's true. They said the deposit would be returned immediately after the inspection.
My older brother used to work at a moving company. Should I ask him for advice?
Really? Are you still working there?

No, I quit last year and now I run a cafe. But I will still share my knowledge.
Thanks, Jiwoo. Did you also send the invitation to the Monday meeting to Mr. Cha?
Yes, I just sent it. By the way, is it okay for Borin to ride the car?
He runs away at the sight of a wheelchair. We need to lure him with treats.
